_about: Message templates and selection rules. This file only shapes text; it never changes stored data.
Each template is a list of lines. {name} is replaced by a value; the full list of names is in the README.
{event_name} is always Forex Factory's exact event name. {headline} / {headline_text} is the generated headline. Keep both.
A missing value is printed as 'missing_value'. A line is dropped entirely when it uses a name listed in 'omit_line_if_missing' for that message type and the value is missing.
Formatting: *bold* and _italic_ only, so the text reads the same in Telegram and WhatsApp.
Three separate things are shown and must stay separate: Forex Factory's Impact, the bot's Gold Relevance, and the bot's Priority.
Wording must stay factual: no market direction, no probability, no statement of what any price will do.

selection._about: Which events each message type covers, and in what order. Priorities and Gold relevance come from the Step 2 classification.

gold_relevance_score._about: Display only: how relevant the event is to this bot's Gold/XAUUSD monitoring framework. Not a probability and not a price forecast. It does not affect the priority score.

result_sentence.ABOVE_FORECAST: The figure came in above the forecast.
result_sentence.BELOW_FORECAST: The figure came in below the forecast.

alert_title._about: Title of the alert, chosen by Forex Factory impact, so 'HIGH-IMPACT' is only used when the source rates the event High.

why_it_matters._about: One sentence per Step 2 category explaining why the event is watched. It must describe relevance only, never a direction. 'default' is used for categories not listed; if that is absent too, the Step 2 relevance reason is shown.
why_it_matters.MONETARY_POLICY: Fed policy decisions can shift interest-rate expectations and the USD, both of which Gold is sensitive to.
why_it_matters.FED_COMMUNICATION: Fed communication can influence rate expectations, the USD and Gold.
why_it_matters.INFLATION: Inflation data can shift rate expectations and USD and yield pricing, making it relevant to Gold.
why_it_matters.EMPLOYMENT: Labour-market data can influence Fed expectations, the USD and Treasury yields.
why_it_matters.GROWTH: Growth data can affect rate expectations and broader risk sentiment.
why_it_matters.CONSUMER_ACTIVITY: Consumer data can influence growth expectations and the policy outlook.
why_it_matters.BUSINESS_ACTIVITY: Business-activity data feeds into the growth outlook and rate expectations.
why_it_matters.MANUFACTURING: Manufacturing surveys are an early read on growth and can influence rate expectations.
why_it_matters.SERVICES: Services-sector data is an early read on growth and can influence rate expectations.
why_it_matters.HOUSING: Housing data is a secondary input for the growth and rate outlook.
why_it_matters.SENTIMENT: Sentiment surveys can influence expectations for consumer demand and inflation.
why_it_matters.GOVERNMENT_FISCAL: Government and Treasury events can occasionally affect the USD and yields.
why_it_matters.TRADE: Trade data has a limited, indirect bearing on the USD.
why_it_matters.ENERGY: Energy inventory data mainly concerns oil and gas and has little direct bearing on Gold.

attribution.FRED: This product uses the FRED® API but is not endorsed or certified by the Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis.

empty: No major USD / Gold events are scheduled for this day.
footer: • Watch the USD reaction around each release.
• Watch Gold volatility if a figure differs materially from expectations.
• Higher-priority events deserve the most attention.
⚠️ Gold relevance is this bot's monitoring assessment, not a prediction of price direction.
